observation: VAJRA dynamic decomposition v1.1 compares the selected organ field to the literal string GUT. A semantically equivalent GUT receipt expressed as sourceOrgan:'gut' is rejected as gut-receipt-required, while dual organ/sourceOrgan declarations are not cross-checked for disagreement.
risk: Schema spelling/case can create false uncertainty or hide a real cross-organ identity conflict. That makes downstream behavior depend on transport representation instead of evidence semantics.
requiredRepair: Canonicalize bounded organ identity case-insensitively after trimming/NFKC.
When both organ and sourceOrgan are present, require their canonical identities to agree.
Preserve disagreement as an explicit rejection rather than silently preferring one alias.
Add adversarial tests for GUT/gut equivalence and GUT/DROPLET disagreement.
Run cross-organ GUT and VAJRA regressions before promotion.
boundary: This evidence records a representational identity defect only. It does not establish source truth, semantic understanding, or persistent capability assimilation.
